title: Griot
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into cubes
instructions: Wash the pork with lime juice and vinegar.
Season with orange juice, onion, garlic, peppers, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Add water and simmer until the pork is tender and the liquid is mostly reduced.
Remove the pork pieces and allow them to dry slightly.
Deep-fry until golden brown and crispy.
Serve with pikliz and rice.

title: Diri Ak Djon Djon

Strain the mushroom liquid and reserve it.

Add rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the mushroom liquid and season with thyme and salt.
Cook until the rice is tender and fluffy.

title: Pikliz
instructions: Combine cabbage, carrots, onion, and peppers in a large bowl.
Add salt and cloves.
Pack into a sterilized jar.
Pour vinegar over the vegetables until fully covered.
Seal and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving.

title: Soup Joumou
instructions: Boil the beef with onion, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper until tender.
Cook the pumpkin separately and blend until smooth.
Add pumpkin puree and vegetables to the beef broth.
Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add pasta and cook until done.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

title: Tassot Kabrit
ingredients: 3 lbs goat meat, cut into chunks
instructions: Wash the goat meat with lime juice.
Season with onion, garlic, thyme, peppers, salt, and black pepper.
Marinate for several hours.
Simmer with water until tender and the liquid reduces.
Allow the meat to dry slightly.
Deep-fry until crispy and browned.
Serve with pikliz.

title: Legim
instructions: Cook the meat until tender.
Boil the vegetables separately until soft.
Mash or blend some of the vegetables for texture.
SautÃ© onion, garlic, and tomato paste.
Combine meat, vegetables, and seasonings.
Simmer for 20 minutes and serve with rice.

title: Banann Peze
instructions: Peel the plantains and cut into thick slices.
Fry until lightly golden.
Flatten each piece with a press or plate.
Fry again until crisp and golden brown.
Sprinkle with salt and serve hot.

title: Akra
instructions: Squeeze excess moisture from the grated malanga.
Mix with garlic, green onions, pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Form into small patties.
Deep-fry until crisp and golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
